description: Validation harness for vessel-repository-independence specification - deterministic static analysis without LLM

pointer.content_summary: TypeScript validation harness that runs 6 test cases to verify vessel independence: (1) No cross-vessel imports from Activity API, (2) No imports from MiniBob, (3) No imports from Dashboard, (4) Self-contained Helm charts, (5) HTTP-based communication, (6) Independent Dockerfiles. Uses ripgrep/grep for pattern matching and filesystem checks. Loads test cases from impulse files. Returns PASS/FAIL without LLM.

usage.programmatic: import { runAllValidations, loadTestCases } from './harness'; const results = runAllValidations(loadTestCases('./impulses'));

outputs.exitCode0: All tests passed - vessel independence enforced
outputs.exitCode1: One or more tests failed - vessel independence violated
outputs.resultFormat: { summary: { total, passed, failed, passRate }, results: [{ testName, severity, pass, actual, expected, details }] }

metadata.purpose: Enable automated validation of vessel-repository-independence without LLM intervention
